3010007.name: Cutlass
3010007.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. A pirate's weapon of choice.

3010008.name: Glass Blade
3010008.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Made from reinforced glass.

3010013.name: Flammenschwert
3010013.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Named for its undulating blade, which resembles the twisting and turning of flames.

3010027.name: Electric Dagger
3010027.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Brimming with electricity, a single touch is enough to paralyze.

3010035.name: Heatwave Blade
3010035.description: A well-crafted piece from another world uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. It is said to be able to carbonize objects with a single slice.

3010053.name: Camping Knife
3010053.description: A well-crafted piece from another world uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. The blade can be folded into the handle and also sports a bottle opener.

3020006.name: War Scythe
3020006.description: A well-crafted uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Can be used for stabbing or slashing attacks above a shield.

3020011.name: Viking Axe
3020011.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Said to have been wielded by great pirates from the far north.

3020012.name: Oxhead Axe
3020012.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Almost as tall as a grown man.

3030007.name: Pike
3030007.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Designed for use by foot soldiers.

3030012.name: Couse
3030012.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This ornate pole weapon is largely used for ceremonial purposes.

3030013.name: Crescent Blade
3030013.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its great curved blade was designed for slashing.

3030027.name: Laser Pilum
3030027.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. A powerful electric current runs through this javelin.

3040003.name: Longbow
3040003.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Embedded with a gem.

3040006.name: Crossbow
3040006.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Mechanical additions make this bow extremely accurate.

3040032.name: Wrist-Mounted Catapult
3040032.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This compact slingshot features a folding grip and can be worn on the wrist, boasting considerable power for its size.

3050002.name: Rohonc Codex
3050002.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This illustrated book is written in an unintelligible language.

3050005.name: The Book of Lies
3050005.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This book of rituals appears, at first glance, to be a collection of poems.

3050010.name: Philebus
3050010.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This dialogue deals in ethics and hedonism.

3060003.name: Priest's Staff
3060003.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. The gem embedded in the head of this staff bears ritualistic significance.

3060007.name: Magic Cane
3060007.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Favored by magicians and illusionists.

3070006.name: Moonblade Knuckles
3070006.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Bears a wicked blade in the shape of a half-moon.

3070010.name: Dragonfist
3070010.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This glove is as tough as the hide of a dragon.

3070018.name: Brass Knuckles
3070018.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. Spiked and made of a light alloy.

3070022.name: Chaos Knuckles
3070022.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. A favorite of thugs, thieves, and others up to no good.

3080008.name: Lapis Buckler
3080008.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Hewn from precious rock.

3080009.name: Knight's Shield
3080009.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Bears the emblem of a noble family.

3080017.name: Wind Aegis
3080017.description: A well-crafted piece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. It's equipped with a device that converts wind into energy.

3090036.name: Polychromatic Earrings
3090036.description: A fine piece from another world unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. These earrings feature crystals linked by chains that change color depending on the humidity.

3100007.name: Iris Blaster
3100007.description: A well-crafted piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its smooth grip makes it quite easy to handle.

4010010.name: Ilhoon
4010010.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. A blade with a curiously wide tip.

4020007.name: Tomahawk
4020007.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its light and well-balanced body makes it perfect for throwing.

4030003.name: Javelin
4030003.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its thin and slender body makes it perfect for throwing.

4030004.name: Twisted Lance
4030004.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This lance, with its spiral ridges, is often used by mounted soldiers.

4030008.name: Partizan
4030008.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its long flat tip makes it suitable for both cutting and thrusting.

4030009.name: Coral Spear
4030009.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Crafted from coral of exceeding toughness.

4030024.name: Wind Chariot
4030024.description: A fine piece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. Not many warriors can wield this double-bladed weapon.

4040007.name: Compound Bow
4040007.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. The pulley system makes this bow easy to handle.

4040008.name: Azusa Bow
4040008.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This mystical bow is said to be effective on yokai.

4040021.name: Ocean Blue Bow
4040021.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Arrows loosed from this bow fly outward in a spiral pattern before piercing their target.

4050004.name: A Treatise on War
4050004.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Contains explications of war stratagems by a well-established general.

4050007.name: Der Nibelunge Liet
4050007.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This epic recounts the tragic lives of a great warrior and his beloved.

4060005.name: Holy Scepter
4060005.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its wings seem ready to bear it off into the heavens.

4060022.name: Blood Staff
4060022.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. A thick, blood-like liquid envelops the entire staff. On rare occasions, it emits an ominous pulse.

4060028.name: Lava Scepter
4060028.description: A fine piece from another world uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. This scepter was created from igneous rocks sourced from three separate volcanoes.

4060032.name: Staff of the Enlightened
4060032.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This metal staff is said to confer divine revelation to its wielder when held up in prayer to a twilit sky.

4060035.name: Protective Parasol
4060035.description: A fine piece from another world unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. This crystal staff features a folding defensive mechanism designed to deflect direct magical attacks.

4070004.name: Crimson Orcfist
4070004.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Its imposing shape is said to resemble an orc's fist.

4070007.name: Force Fist
4070007.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This mechanical glove amplifies the force of each blow.

4080003.name: Diamond Shield
4080003.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Crafted from near indestructible diamond.

4080015.name: Lindwurm
4080015.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. Adorned with a fearsome serpent's crest.

4080019.name: Thundercrest Shield
4080019.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. It bears the symbol of an indigenous god of thunder.

4080021.name: Record Scratcher
4080021.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a different world. The record at the device's center emits a powerful signal capable of acting as a shield for the user.

4080027.name: Handheld Bunker
4080027.description: A fine piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a different world. Its sturdy handle and thick padding add to its defensive prowess.

5010028.name: Tyrfing
5010028.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. In exchange for fulfilling its wielder's deepest desire, this cursed sword takes the life of the one dearest to them.

5010061.name: First Light
5010061.description: An exquisite piece from another world unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. This crystal sword is said to cleave space itself as the flash of its dew-drenched blade melts into the light.

5020008.name: Ukonvasara
5020008.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. It's rumored that nothing can stand against this mighty weapon.

5020010.name: Death's Sickle
5020010.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Bears an uncanny resemblance to the choice weapon of the Grim Reaper.

5020030.name: Infernal Axe
5020030.description: An exquisite piece from another world uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. This hatchet is said to have been wielded by a renowned commander beloved by his subordinates.

5020037.name: Grim Scythe
5020037.description: An exquisite piece from another world uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. The blade's thick back easily deflects attacks, allowing the wielder to mow down their staggered opponents.

5030025.name: Storm Trident
5030025.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Bearing traces of lightning in its tips, it is capable of piercing any fish.

5040010.name: Meteora
5040010.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Arrows shot from this bow streak down from the sky like meteors.

5040016.name: Predator
5040016.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope. The second string helps this enchanted bow shoot arrows at an incredible speed.

5050009.name: Senji Ryakketsu
5050009.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Said to be written by a legendary diviner.

5060009.name: Astrolabe Staff
5060009.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. The orbs floating about it are said to reflect the positions of stars in space.

5060025.name: Blaugandr
5060025.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. The sound of running water echoes from within the crystal embedded in the staff.

5070023.name: Totemic Cestus
5070023.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. These gauntlets are inscribed with glyphs of a certain guardian deity.

5070036.name: Noblesse Oblige
5070036.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. This resplendent bracelet features an anecdote given by a person of exceptional virtue.

5080007.name: Amanoiwa Shield
5080007.description: An exquisite piece uncovered in the Kaleidoscope, likely from a distant world. Appears ancient, but sturdy.

5100002.name: Warship 343
5100002.description: An exquisite piece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. It's equipped with bullets that can pierce through tanks and warships.
